branch_taken: plan 047 next_if_fail, GDET clause (Exact, GATES_047 c0b59d5, ledger 9b28e89): 'GDET fails: the conflict cap is not deterministic on this solver; find the nondeterminism source before anything else.' GDET failed only on its wall_guard clause: canon16d was byte-identical between API16D and API16D_b on 18/18 fresh cases [0.824, 1.000] with 0 firings in the main block, but the 30 s wall guard fired 7 times on 3 a3_046 replay records (11230004, 11230008, 11230009) whose calls ran at 6716 to 9797 conflicts/s, below the 294000 / 30 s = 9800/s needed to reach C first. GQB22 also failed (A16_N 16.718 s vs 10.5 s; API16D 43.778 s vs 30 s). GFID16D, GFID_wall and GAPI16D_fresh passed (10/12 [0.552, 0.953], WRONG 0). Candidate source (Inferred, #168 item 3): the cap is too large for the slowest calls under load, so the clock enters through the guard. The maintainer also asked that scale-20 be made feasible within 3600 s; this plan does both in one run, with the scale-20 claim conditional on the determinism gate
brand: charcoal and sage; no purple, neon, emoji or gold
question: Is the 047 GDET failure explained by the conflict cap being too large, so that the wall guard decides slow calls? With a smaller fixed cap (C = 50000, chosen so the slowest call rate seen in 047 reaches C in under half the 30 s guard), does certify/16d run with 0 guard firings and byte-identical passes, on fresh 16-state worlds, on the sealed 046 traces that fired the guard in 047, and on a first set of fresh 20-state worlds, inside a 3600 s run? Does it stay sound at N = 20?

hypotheses.H1: at C = 50000 the wall guard fires 0 times on every certify/16d record, including the 3 sealed 046 traces (11230004, 11230008, 11230009) that fired it in 047
hypotheses.H2: with no guard firing, two independent passes of certify/16d give byte-identical canonical records on every fresh case (scale16, control and scale20)
hypotheses.H3: on fresh scale16 worlds certify/16d at C = 50000 issues no WRONG certificate and decides at least 7/12 (the A16_N 046 count, as 047)
hypotheses.H4: scale-20 (exploratory): at family_bound 20 certify/16d stays sound (WRONG 0, every decided record audited true at bound 20); the decided count is reported, not predicted
hypotheses.H5: the smaller cap costs decided cases relative to 047 (10/12 at C 294000); reported, not gated

design.api: no new API code: the frozen brute/api/certify16d.py (v0.44.0, sha as in BRUTE_SOURCE_FREEZE_047) is driven only through its public interface with new parameter values. The wall guard stays at the certify/16d defaults (30 s per call, 600 s per case) and is not tuned. Any new behaviour (runner, canonical record, recount, reference, gates) goes in new _048 files; every frozen file is imported only
design.cap_rule: fixed NOW, before any 048 data, from sealed 047 public results only (Exact): conflict_cap C = 50000 for every part. Reason (Inferred): the slowest 047 rate on any certify/16d call is 6716 conflicts/s (scale16, a3_046 11230004, a guard-stopped call, so a lower bound on that call), giving 7.4 s per capped call at scale16; the slowest smoke scale20 rate was 9112.8/s unloaded, and scaling by the 047 load ratio 6716/17332.9 = 0.387 gives about 3528/s loaded, i.e. 14.2 s per capped scale20 call, under half the 30 s guard. Case budgets: B16 = 1500000 conflicts (scale16 and control, 30 capped calls), B20 = 1000000 (scale20, 20 capped calls). No calibration step and no 048 smoke data choose C or B; the smoke only checks the projection

arms.API16D: certify/16d through its public interface, C 50000, B16 or B20, K = 128, declared N = 16 (scale16, control) or 20 (scale20)
arms.API16D_b: the same arm run as a second independent pass in separate processes, cases in reverse seed order (determinism check only)

parts.a_fresh16: 18 fresh cases (12 scale16, 6 control), API16D and API16D_b (36 jobs)
parts.r_replay046: API16D (one pass) replays the 18 sealed 046 A16_N fresh traces (12 scale16, 6 control) observation by observation, as part a3_046 of 047 but at C = 50000 (18 jobs). The 3 traces that fired the guard in 047 are named in advance: 11230004, 11230008, 11230009. Differences from the sealed record are classified with the 047 classes (#167 item 9) and reported, not gated
parts.d_scale20: 8 fresh scale20 worlds (generator experiments/worlds_047.py, scale20 family, unchanged), API16D and API16D_b (16 jobs)

design.canonical_record: canon16d as in 047 (no wall fields: label, n_min, model, every proposed word, per-call conflicts and capped flags)
design.claim: certify/16d ID/IDF is exact conditional on noise-free readings and true size <= the declared N (family_bound); reason (Inferred): a larger machine can copy the true machine on every visited state, so some size bound is inherent
design.dropped: the wall-capped arms A16_N and API16 are not run: the question is about certify/16d alone, and their GQB22 overrun stays Open (reported in #168). No 045 replays
design.unchanged: encoding, clauses, cube split, rival query, distinguishing-word rule, K, labels, AMB/K_spent rule and recount rule are those of 047

criteria.GFID48: headline 3, fidelity: API16D driven observation by observation over its own part-a and part-d traces reproduces 26/26 records exactly (api_checks)
criteria.GAPI16D_fresh48: headline 4: fresh scale16: API16D WRONG = 0 and ID+IDF >= 7/12 (Wilson 95% CI reported). A capped unknown is not a WRONG

gate_dependency_rule: each gate is scored from its own counts. GAPI16D_fresh48 and GS20_sound use the recounted labels if G_recount passes, else the study labels with the failure stated. GS20_sound is not run if part d is cut
what_counts_as_failure: any gated criterion false. A capped call is unknown, not a failure of soundness. A wall_guard firing is a GDET48 failure (and a GWALL_r failure in part r)
freeze_rule: no file named in the source freeze is edited after the freeze; new behaviour goes in new files or a deviation addendum. C, B16, B20 and the case lists are part of the freeze
runtime_estimate: declared now, using the #167 item 13 worst-case definition with the stricter rates: r_min(key) = the smaller of the 048 smoke slowest rate and the 047 loaded rate (scale16 6716/s; scale20 3528/s estimated). Per job: min(600 s case guard, B / r_min + 10 s); controls count their smoke mean. Worst case: part a scale16 24 x (1500000/6716 + 10 = 233.3 s) = 5599 s; part r scale16 12 x 233.3 = 2800 s; part d 16 x (1000000/3528 + 10 = 293.4 s) = 4694 s; controls about 30 s; total about 13123 job-seconds; LPT on 8 workers about 1640 s plus at most one 293 s tail, about 1940 s, below 3600 s. Cut rule, declared now: if the pre-freeze worst-case LPT projection is above 3600 s, part d is reduced to 6 scale20 cases (seeds 11610001-11610006), then to 4 (11610001-11610004); if 4 still projects above 3600 s, part d is dropped and scale-20 gets its own version (v0.46.0). Nothing else is cut. The cut is declared in the pre-run deviation before the freeze
